name: Sparse Brick Set Rendering
definition: A rendering method using hardware-accelerated raytracing against a BVH of brick AABBs, where leaf bricks contain SDF data and are intersected via software shaders and sphere-tracing.
summary: Sparse Brick Set Rendering renders Signed Distance Fields using hardware BVH traversal and software sphere-tracing within leaf bricks, differing from other methods by relying on software intersection shaders rather than hardware-native primitives.
